nodes.speaker: Preacher Boone
nodes.text: Heard about the train, brother. Like the good book probably says: render unto the town what was the town's, and unto Caesar a very long walk home.

choices.text: Fairly sure Caesar had a horse.

nodes.speaker: Preacher Boone
nodes.text: Not after the coupling got shot, he didn't.

nodes.speaker: Preacher Boone
nodes.text: Walking builds character. Vane's engine took a great deal of character with it when it left.
